title: Architectural Solutions Manager
description:
**trueceil™ | Architectural Metal Ceiling Systems**

**Location:**
Kerala

**Experience:**
1–5 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Qualification:**
Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, or a related field

**Build a Career Where Architecture Meets Innovation.**

What if your career in architecture went beyond drawings and designs?

At
**trueceil™**
, we believe ceilings are more than just functional elements. They are an opportunity to shape spaces, create visual impact, and bring architectural ideas to life.

We are building a new generation of architectural metal ceiling solutions designed for contemporary spaces. As we grow, we are looking for an
**Architectural Solutions Manager**
who is passionate about architecture, curious about materials and technical design, and excited to work closely with architects, interior designers, and project teams.

This is an opportunity to step into the world of
**architectural products, ceiling systems, technical specifications, and design-led business development,**
gaining practical experience in how products are presented, specified, and selected for real projects.

If you enjoy understanding how things are designed, explaining how they work, and helping turn design concepts into practical solutions, this role could be the beginning of an exciting career.

**What Will You Do?**

1. Work with Architects & Designers

·       Build professional relationships with architects, interior designers, consultants, and design studios.

·       Understand project requirements and explore how trueceil™ products can complement their design concepts.

·       Present suitable ceiling systems, finishes, configurations, and applications for different spaces.

·       Help design professionals discover new possibilities in architectural metal ceilings.

2. Develop Architectural & Product Presentations

·       Prepare compelling product presentations, digital brochures, technical documents, and visual references.

·       Create project-specific presentations that communicate product features, design possibilities, and application benefits.

·       Assist in developing material presentations and product showcases for architects and design teams.

·       Translate technical product information into clear, engaging, and professional presentations.

3. Coordinate Technical Specifications

·       Understand product dimensions, materials, finishes, installation systems, and application requirements.

·       Assist in preparing product specifications, technical submittals, and supporting documentation.

·       Coordinate with internal teams to address technical queries and identify suitable product configurations.

·       Support the specification process by helping ensure the right trueceil™ products are considered for relevant projects.

4. Explore Projects & Present Solutions

·       Identify upcoming projects where trueceil™ ceiling systems could be suitable.

·       Introduce products to prospective clients and present solutions based on their requirements.

·       Follow up on project discussions, product presentations, samples, and specification opportunities.

·       Coordinate with the sales and technical teams to help convert product interest into actual project opportunities.

5. Learn, Experiment & Grow

·       Develop an in-depth understanding of architectural ceiling systems and their applications.

·       Learn how architects evaluate materials, how specifications influence product selection, and how projects progress from design to execution.

·       Stay updated on architectural materials, interior trends, product innovations, and emerging design possibilities.

·       Contribute ideas to improve how trueceil™ products are presented, understood, and adopted by the design community.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

·       Has an interest in architecture, interior spaces, materials, and product design.

·       Enjoys communicating ideas, building relationships, and presenting information.

·       Is curious about technical details and willing to learn how architectural products work.

·       Can create clear, professional presentations and communicate confidently.

·       Is comfortable interacting with architects, designers, and other industry professionals.

·       Has a proactive mindset and the confidence to initiate conversations and follow up on opportunities.

·       Can balance creative thinking with technical accuracy and commercial awareness.

Fresh graduates with the right attitude are encouraged to apply.
Prior experience in architectural products, building materials, technical sales, or specification-related work is an advantage, but not essential.

**What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

A career at the intersection of design and business.

This is not a conventional sales role, nor is it a position limited to preparing drawings or documents.

You will learn how architectural products are evaluated, presented, specified, and selected, while developing the communication and commercial skills needed to work effectively with design professionals.

**You will gain exposure to:**

·       
**Architectural products:**
Understand metal ceiling systems, finishes, configurations, and applications.

·       
**Technical design:**
Develop knowledge of product details, system components, and application requirements.

·       
**Specification work:**
Learn how product specifications and technical submissions support project decisions.

·       
**Design communication:**
Present product possibilities and solutions to architects and interior designers.

·       
**Business development:**
Understand how relationships, project opportunities, and product specifications translate into business.

This role can be a strong foundation for a long-term career in architectural products, specification management, technical solutions, product management, or architectural business development.

**Why Join trueceil™?**

·       
**Build a specialised skill set:**
Develop knowledge in a growing area of architectural interior systems.

·       
**Work with design professionals:**
Engage directly with architects, designers, and project teams.

·       
**Learn beyond the classroom:**
Gain practical exposure to real projects, products, and specification processes.

·       
**Combine creativity with technical knowledge:**
Work with both the design possibilities and the practical requirements of ceiling systems.

·       
**Grow with an emerging brand:**
Be part of trueceil as it develops its presence in the architectural products market.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**

If you are looking for more than a routine job, and want to build expertise, develop professional relationships, and understand how architecture translates into real world product decisions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join TRUECEIL™ and help architects look at ceilings differently.**

**Apply now**

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

You will handle complex, high\-stakes enrollments, enforce strict operational boundaries, and provide data\-driven insights to the Hub Manager/Founder.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Honest Intake \& Deep Counseling:**
* **The 45\-Minute Session:** 
 Run comprehensive counseling sessions at the center (ideally with a parent present). Explain the course architecture and present the reality of the program honestly, explicitly including the demanding aspects that put people off.
* **Qualify \& Firmly Disqualify:** 
 Record exactly why a lead is not a fit. Turn away prospects who require classroom teaching or cannot commit to six days a week—kindly, but firmly.
* **Protect the Schedule:** 
 Enforce strict intake rules. Cohorts open every Monday. Never promise a start date that is not a Monday, a gate that is not a Thursday or Friday, or a guaranteed job.
* **Closing \& Financial Administration:**
* **Secure Enrollments:** 
 Walk students through the enrollment agreement clause by clause. Secure guardian signatures for students under 18 and guardian contact details for those under 21\.
* **Collection \& Handoff:** 
 Collect and receipt the ₹10,000 registration fee. Collect the student's GitHub username and complete the hand\-off to the Operations Manager for account creation before the Monday start.
* **Caseload Escalation \& Retention:**
* **Fee Ledger Management:** 
 Remind students at 7 days overdue and escalate at 21 days. Enforce the strict consequence: they may finish their current module but cannot start the next until cleared. Never threaten portal access or gate access over money.
* **Pauses, Exits \& Refunds:** 
 Process pause requests within the strict 8\-week cap. When a student exits, record the date immediately, calmly and accurately explain the refund band, and pass the refund processing to the Operations Manager.
* **Post\-Completion:** 
 Enter the placement record when a student secures a job and conduct the six\-month "how did it go" follow\-up call.
* **Team Leadership, QA \& Reporting:**
* Coach and mentor Junior Counselors, standardizing sales scripts and enforcing CRM hygiene.
* Take ownership of the aggregate enquiry\-to\-enrollment funnel, monitor KPIs, and report bottlenecks to leadership.
* Handle high\-priority escalations, student disputes, and third\-strike interventions.

 Comfortable using CRM data and analytics to track performance and enforce operational rules.

 Strong understanding of current academic trends, career pathways, and curriculum structures.
